title: Designing a Durable Interface for This Portfolio
author: Sarath Kumar
summary: How this portfolio balances storytelling, motion, and developer empathy without sacrificing clarity.
content: This portfolio is intentionally built as an editorial artifact, not a feature showcase. The core aim is simple: tell a clear story about how I work, back it with real delivery evidence, and make each section easy to scan for recruiters and engineering teams.

I design the information flow first: who I am, what I shipped, how I make decisions, and how to contact me. Motion and visual texture come after structure, and only when they improve reading. If an interaction delays proof, it gets reduced or removed.

Durability here means consistency across the entire system. Home, projects, blogs, and modals follow the same interaction language, typography rhythm, and accessibility behavior. The result should feel crafted without being fragile: expressive enough to be memorable, but disciplined enough to stay trustworthy.
